🌊 Liquidity Update | 3 November

The latest data do not show a broad liquidity expansion. They show a temporary release of Treasury cash inside a system where bank reserves have fallen and the price of funding remains restrictive.

🏦 The weekly plumbing moved in the wrong

Everyone's blaming midterm nerves for the chop. The plumbing has been doing quiet work too: bank reserves fell from $3.03T on Oct 7 to $2.89T by Oct 28 (FRED) as the Treasury rebuilt its cash account to about $1.0T.

That's roughly $136B pulled out of the system in three weeks.
